observations: 16 of 25 primary URLs resolve correctly (64% success rate)
Bot blocking (HTTP 403/418) is the most common failure mode — 5 sites block automated access but likely work in browsers
2 URLs return 404 suggesting the organization restructured their website (CFA Institute, BIS)
1 site has an expired/invalid TLS certificate (datascienceassn.org) suggesting the organization may be defunct or domain lapsed
All FAO, ICMM, IFJ, ISC2 international URLs resolve correctly
All low-coverage sector URLs (Agriculture, Mining, Construction) resolve correctly — 5/5 success
If bot-blocked sites are excluded, the true 'broken' rate drops to ~12% (3 of 25)

method: WebFetch automated HTTP check with content verification
